newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Sept NGL to Vitol at $34/t under Med.
newsitem.headline: India sells Sept NGL to Vitol at $34/t under Med.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold through tender 25,000 tonnes of natural gas liquids (NGL) lifting from Hazira between September 24-26 to Dutch trader Vitol at $34 per tonne below Mediterranean quotes on a free-on-board basis, traders said on Monday.
The tender closed on September 12 and was valid until September 13.
Traders said the last IOC tender for a cargo lifting September 14-16, also from Hazira, was awarded to a Brazilian company at "aggressive" but private and confidential levels.
